prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design the category-standard version of Sylph, a refined dark agent IDE for remote product-building Workspaces.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed 1600x1000 desktop application, no device frame and no marketing page.
Structure: Conventional resizable three-pane IDE. Left sidebar contains Workspaces and file tree. Center contains code editor with tabs and a browser preview tab. Right rail contains agent conversation and a prompt composer. Bottom panel contains checks and concise run output. Top chrome carries Sylph, repository, branch, search and account.
Content: Workspace Checkout restoration, repository folkhero-web, task Polish the onboarding flow; files src/routes/onboarding.tsx and src/styles/app.css; browser preview shows a tasteful SaaS onboarding screen; status Browser checks 4/4, Agent controlling browser, Live.
Style/medium: Impeccably executed modern dark developer tool. Precise hairline dividers, mature spacing, excellent typography, restrained syntax colors, native-feeling controls.
Composition/framing: Dense, highly legible, immediately recognizable as an IDE. Browser preview remains large enough to work in, but no unconventional visual metaphor.
Lighting/mood: Quiet, professional, low-glare.
Color palette: application black #0F1115, foreground #E7EAF0, panel #272C35, blue accent #4F7CFF, restrained green and amber statuses.
Materials/textures: clean application chrome, matte panels, crisp glass screen.
Text (verbatim where shown): Sylph, Checkout restoration, folkhero-web, Polish the onboarding flow, src/routes/onboarding.tsx, Browser checks 4/4, Agent controlling browser, Live.
Constraints: Must read as a credible shipping cloud IDE with files, code, agent conversation, skills, browser preview and testing. Accessible contrast. No invented business claims.
Avoid: visual novelty, metaphorical decoration, bento dashboard, glowing neon borders, glassmorphism, marketing hero, device frame, excessive pills, tiny illegible text.
